answer_1.quote: Our goal is to generate a text caption y describing a salient pattern in an input time series x... We collect and release two datasets consisting of time series data with accompanying English language description of salient patterns.
answer_1.outputs: English textual captions describing patterns in the time series

answer_2.quote: We report Perplexity (PPL), BLEU-3/4 (2002), METEOR, ROUGE-L (Rouge), and BertScore-Precision (BERT). The proposed TRUCE method gets favorable scores as per various automated metrics on the test split of SYNTH.

answer_4.quote: We recruit human annotators who are requested to provide a binary label on factual correctness (COR) of the captions for the test split. Each caption is annotated by three annotators, and the majority label is used.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators provide a binary label indicating whether the generated caption is factually correct with respect to the input time series.
